summary: Answer strict exact RFI Spec Section questions from explicitly labelled same-RFI primary evidence before model dispatch.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient and accurate file-grounded support across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Submittal already exposes an exact labelled Spec Section while RFI retained only model-backed access
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer the exact field without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI and its Spec Section use the local shortcut.
Only explicit Spec Section or Specification Section labels in exact primary evidence participate; unlabeled CSI values do not.
Conflicting values, wrong or multiple RFI scope, quoted history, vision narration and more than 32 primary files or candidate passages fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer applicability, section hierarchy, revision, status or controlling authority.
